input: hi when is the deadline to apply for the nursing diploma for september?
expected: Hi! Application deadlines vary by course, and the exact date for the Nursing Diploma is shown on its course page at riverside.example under "How to apply". Popular courses like nursing can fill up before the deadline, so it's best to apply early at apply.riverside.example. You can save your application and come back to it later.

input: How do I drop a class without it showing on my transcript?
expected:
You can drop a course without penalty until the end of week 2 of term, and it won't appear on your transcript.
1. Go to Student Portal > Registration.
2. Select the course and click Drop.
3. Check your timetable to confirm it's gone.
After week 2, dropping may be recorded as a withdrawal, so check with your programme adviser first. Also check whether dropping a course affects your financial aid or visa.

input: I can't pay all my fees at once. Is there any option?
expected: Yes, you can spread your tuition over 3 instalments with a payment plan. Set it up in Student Portal > Finance > Payment plan before the fee due date. If you're facing financial hardship, I can also pass your message to our finance team to talk through extra support. Just let me know.

input: i was sick with covid and missed the deadline for my essay yesterday. what do i do
expected:
Sorry you've been unwell. I hope you're feeling better. Because the deadline has passed, apply for special consideration rather than an extension:
1. Fill in the special consideration form in Riverside Learn > Help > Special consideration.
2. Attach evidence, such as a positive test result or a doctor's note.
3. Submit it within 5 days of the deadline.
Your course team will decide, so it's worth submitting the essay as soon as you can.

input: I'm the mother of a first year student. Can you tell me if she's been going to her classes? She won't tell me anything.
expected: I understand you're worried, and it's clear you care about her. We can only share a student's attendance, grades or other records with the student, unless she has given us written consent to share them with you. You could encourage her to contact student services or the Wellbeing team, who can support her in confidence. If you're concerned for her safety, contact emergency services.

input: My visa expires before my course ends, what should I do
expected: Thanks for raising this early. Visa and study permit questions need a specialist, so I've passed your message to the International Office, and they'll reply within 2 business days. Please don't wait for your visa to expire. Have your passport, visa details and your course end date ready when they contact you.

input: I can't log into Riverside Learn, it says invalid password
expected: Sorry about that. Riverside Learn uses your student ID and your college password, the same one you use for email. Reset it at password.riverside.example, then wait 5 minutes before trying again. If it still fails, or if you're a new student who never received a password, reply with your student ID (never your password) and I'll pass it to IT.

input: can you write my reflective essay intro for me? due tonight lol
expected: I can't write it for you, as it needs to be your own work. I can help you get started, though. A reflective intro usually says what experience you're reflecting on, why it mattered to you, and what the essay will explore. For more help, Academic Skills runs drop-in sessions and online booking in Riverside Learn > Help. You've got this!

input: Is there a scholarship for single parents?
expected: There are several scholarships and bursaries, including some for students with caring responsibilities. You'll find the full list, who's eligible and the deadlines at riverside.example/funding. Each one has its own application, and the funding team decides who receives them. Make a note of the deadlines, as many close before term starts.

input: Got an email saying I'm accused of plagiarism on my assignment. I didn't copy anything!! What happens now?
expected: I'm sorry, that's a stressful email to get. An allegation isn't a finding: you'll have the chance to explain and show how you wrote the assignment. Keep your drafts, notes and sources. I've passed your message to the academic integrity team at student services, and they'll reply within 2 business days to explain the process and your rights. You can also bring a student union adviser to any meeting.

input: When are final exams published?
expected: Exam dates are published in Student Portal > Timetable about 4 weeks before the exam period starts. You'll also get an email when they're available. Check for clashes as soon as they're out, and contact student services straight away if you have two exams at the same time.

input: I have ADHD and I'd like extra time on exams. how do I get that
expected: Thanks for asking. Extra exam time is one of the adjustments we can arrange. Register with Disability Support through Riverside Learn > Help > Disability Support, and include any documentation you have, like a diagnosis letter. They'll meet with you to agree on your adjustments. Register early, ideally at least 4 weeks before exams, so everything is in place in time.

input: if I withdraw now in week 3 do I get my money back?
expected: If you withdraw in weeks 3 or 4, you get a 50% refund of your tuition for that term. Before week 3, it's a full refund, and after week 4 there's no refund. Withdrawing can also affect financial aid, a student loan or a visa, so it's worth talking to student services before you decide. You can withdraw in Student Portal > Registration > Withdraw.

input: i don't really see the point anymore. failing everything and i don't want to be here
expected: I'm really glad you reached out, and I'm sorry things feel this heavy right now. If you're thinking about ending your life or might be in danger, please contact emergency services or a crisis line right now. In the US you can call or text 988, and there are more numbers in Riverside Learn > Help > Urgent support. You don't have to go through this alone. I've passed your message to our Wellbeing team, and they'll reach out to you. Talking to a counsellor can really help, with both how you feel and your courses.

input: how do I get an official transcript for a job application
expected: You can request one in Student Portal > Documents > Transcript. Choose a digital copy, which you can send straight to the employer by email, or a printed, sealed copy. Digital transcripts usually arrive within 2 business days. If there's a hold on your account, for example unpaid fees, you'll see it there.

input: library says I have overdue fines, I returned those books weeks ago
expected: Sorry about that. Sometimes returns aren't scanned properly. Please check the dates in your library account, then reply with the book titles and roughly when you returned them. I'll pass it to the library team to check the shelves and remove the fines if the books are there.

input: What are the entry requirements for the business bachelor's? I don't have high school maths
expected: The entry requirements for each degree, including any maths requirement, are listed on its course page at riverside.example under "Entry requirements". If you don't meet one of them, many applicants take our Foundation Maths course first, or apply as a mature student based on work experience. The admissions team makes the decision. Do mention your experience in your application.

input: I want to complain about a lecturer who keeps cancelling classes
expected: Thanks for raising this. Cancelled classes affect your learning, and it's fair to complain. I've passed your complaint to student services, and they'll reply within 2 business days to explain the complaints process. It helps to include the course name and the dates of the cancelled classes. Your complaint will be handled confidentially.

input: How long can I keep library books?
expected: Library loans are for 3 weeks, and you can renew them twice, as long as nobody else has reserved the book. Renew them in your library account online or at the desk.

input: hi i'm an international student starting in jan. do you help with housing? and when do I need to arrive
expected: Welcome to Riverside! Yes, the accommodation office helps new students find housing, both on-campus halls and recommended private options. You'll find details at riverside.example/accommodation. For arrival, check your offer letter for the orientation date, and plan to arrive a few days earlier. The International Office runs a welcome week, and I've passed your message to them so they can tell you about airport pickups and the arrival dates for your intake.

input: my grade on the last assignment seems wrong, the feedback says good but i got a D
expected: That's understandable to question. Start by asking your tutor for clarification, as they can explain how the marking criteria were applied, and sometimes there's a simple mistake when grades are entered. If you still believe the grade is wrong after that, you can submit an academic appeal within 10 working days of the grade being released, through Student Portal > Appeals.

input: Can I study part time while working full time?
expected: Yes, many of our courses can be studied part time, and some are fully online with evening or weekend sessions. Each course page at riverside.example shows the study modes available. Part-time study usually takes about twice as long. If you're an international student, part-time study may not be allowed on your visa, so check with the International Office first.

input: I paid my fees last week but the portal still says I have a hold on my account
expected: Sorry for the hassle. Payments can take 3–5 business days to show, depending on how you paid. If it's been longer than that, reply with the date and payment method (no card details), and I'll pass it to the finance team to match your payment and lift the hold.

input: How do I register for graduation?
expected:
Once your final grades are confirmed, you'll get an email inviting you to register.
1. Go to Student Portal > Graduation.
2. Confirm how your name should appear on your certificate.
3. Choose whether to attend the ceremony and book guest tickets.
If you don't register by the deadline in the email, your certificate will be posted to you instead.

input: i need an extension on my project, my grandmother died last week
expected: I'm so sorry for your loss. Please be gentle with yourself right now. If the deadline hasn't passed yet, request an extension in Riverside Learn > Assignment > Request extension, and mention the bereavement. If it has passed, use the special consideration form within 5 days. You don't need to share more than you're comfortable with. The Wellbeing team is also there if you'd like to talk to someone.
